---
title: "wrapped fixture: width and gap options on code cells"
filters:
  - wrapped
wrapped:
  width: 45%
  gap: 20px
format:
  html: default
  pdf:
    keep-tex: true
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    fig-format: png
  docx: default
---

A knitr cell's `#| width:` and `#| wrap-gap:` reach its table float, so the
table takes them over the document's `wrapped:` width and gap. A cell with
neither takes the document's.

## A table cell with its class in classes

```{r}
#| label: tbl-cell-opts
#| tbl-cap: "A table cell with width and wrap-gap."
#| classes: wrap-right
#| width: 30%
#| wrap-gap: 3em
knitr::kable(head(cars, 3))
```

## A table cell with its class in its caption block

```{r}
#| label: tbl-cell-cap
#| tbl-cap: "A table cell with its class in the caption. {.wrap-left}"
#| width: 35%
#| wrap-gap: 2em
knitr::kable(head(cars, 3))
```

The paragraph after the table cell with its class in its caption block.
